status: Experimental smaller-section proposal; Building Regulations compliance not demonstrated
basis: UK first-generation Eurocode gravity combinations, 1.35 Gk + 1.50 Qk for the modelled adverse floor action; S355 grade with thickness-dependent yield strength. Member sizes remain preliminary. No safety factor has been reduced.
outstanding: Confirm actual permanent loads, partition positions, concentrated floor loads and every roof reaction; floor-only calculations do not verify roof support.
Check lateral-torsional stability and design compression-flange and end restraint, including construction stages.
Assess whole-floor vibration, deflection of flexible receiving supports and cumulative movement across connected beams and joists.
Agree movement limits and installation sequence with the ceiling, partition, glazing and floor-finish designs; 20 mm is an assumed coordination target, not a regulatory allowance.
Design steel joints, joist connections, web bearing/stiffeners, padstones and local masonry eccentricity and compression.
Verify the complete load path, wall stability, foundations, ground conditions and fire protection before construction.

M-FR-3-001.role: Internal loft floor cross-beam over the open suite

serviceability.basis: Variable-action L/360 follows the UK NA suggested limit for beams carrying brittle finishes. Total min(L/250,20 mm) is a provisional project target for this floor-only comparison, not a statutory rule or permission for 20 mm movement at finishes. Retain hold until cumulative movement, vibration and finishes are checked.

M-FR-3-010.role: North loft floor transfer; roof and glazing reactions unresolved

serviceability.basis: Provisional floor-only min(L/250,20 mm) total and L/360 variable check. If the receiver carries roof, facade or glazing loads, confirm those actions and adopt their movement limits before accepting this section; the floor-only result does not authorise that use.

M-CJ01-GROUND-HEAD.role: Wide ground-floor opening head below the first-floor joists

serviceability.basis: Retain the previous min(L/360,10 mm) total project target. The reduced section is checked against the same modelled gravity assumptions; complete loading, restraint, connections and finishes remain unverified.

M-GABLE-FLOOR-BLOCK.role: West wall transfer carrying the loft cross-beam end reaction

serviceability.basis: Retain min(L/360,10 mm) total for the wall-carrying transfer. The masonry/roof line-load budgets remain assumptions; actual wall and roof reactions, bearing eccentricity and crack control must be established.
